data_flow_stages.name: GitHub API/Webhook → Provider Packet
data_flow_stages.description: GitHub API/webhook → HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and permission gate → rate-limit budget check → idempotency/dedup ledger check → content-light normalization and redaction → schema validation → JSON/JSONL artifact → Postgres operational projection → DuckDB analytical projection (disposable, where useful) → cockpit/static docs/API projection
data_flow_stages.redaction_rule: Strip Authorization headers, X-Hub-Signature-256, and any token-bearing fields before storage. Redact PII (email, full_name, ip_address) from raw payload if present. Retain pseudonymized actor_id.
data_flow_stages.retention_rule: Raw packets retained 30 days. After 30 days, keep only the hash_provenance_fields and drop the raw JSON payload.
data_flow_stages.replay_rule: Replay detection: check idempotency_key existence in github_provider_packet before processing. If duplicate, log to duplicate_packet_quarantine and skip. Time-window: reject packets older than 7 days (stale).
data_flow_stages.failure_quarantine_behavior: Failed packets (schema validation error, parse error) move to .rig/relay/github/quarantine/packets/{installation_id}/{timestamp}_{reason}.json. Emit rig.relay.github.packet.quarantined event. Retry 3x with exponential backoff before permanent quarantine.

data_flow_stages.name: Provider Packet → Schema Validation
data_flow_stages.redaction_rule: Fields that failed validation and were coerced/defaulted are marked with a validation_override flag. Original raw field values are not retained in the validated artifact.
data_flow_stages.retention_rule: Validated packets retained 90 days. Schema validation errors retained permanently for schema evolution analysis.
data_flow_stages.replay_rule: Schema version drift: if the validated packet was produced with an older schema version, re-validate with the current schema before processing downstream. Emit rig.relay.github.schema.revalidated event.
data_flow_stages.failure_quarantine_behavior: Schema validation failures move to .rig/relay/github/quarantine/validation/{resource_type}/{timestamp}_{reason}.json. Include the original packet_sha256 reference but not the raw content. Surfaces in cockpit as a Schema Validation widget with failure counts per resource_type.

data_flow_stages.name: Schema Validation → Content-Light Normalization
data_flow_stages.redaction_rule: Content-light normalization drops all raw markdown/text bodies from issues, PR descriptions, comments, code snippets, and diff hunks. Retain only: titles, labels, state, timestamps, actor_ids, and structured metadata. For code scanning alerts, retain rule_id, severity, path, line_number, but drop surrounding source code. For secret scanning, retain secret_type, path, but drop the secret value. Content-light principle: enough metadata to answer analytical questions, zero raw source code.
data_flow_stages.retention_rule: Normalized JSONL retained indefinitely (content-light by construction). Full-content artifacts retained only in raw packets (30-day TTL).
data_flow_stages.replay_rule: If normalization logic changes (normalizer_version increment), re-normalize from validated packets. Emit rig.relay.github.normalization.reapplied event.
data_flow_stages.failure_quarantine_behavior: Normalization failures (unexpected resource shape, missing required fields) move to .rig/relay/github/quarantine/normalization/{resource_type}/{timestamp}_{reason}.json. Block downstream processing until the normalizer is updated to handle the new resource shape.

data_flow_stages.name: Content-Light Normalization → JSON/JSONL Artifact
data_flow_stages.redaction_rule: Already content-light from stage 3. Additional redaction: drop actor_id if telemetry mode is disabled, replace with anonymous placeholder. Strip all internal file paths (keep repo-relative paths only).
data_flow_stages.retention_rule: Report artifacts retained indefinitely. These are the canonical append-only record. GC of old artifacts is prohibited per governance doctrine.
data_flow_stages.replay_rule: Report artifacts are append-only. Replay means re-processing from normalized source. Duplicate detection via report_sha256. If a report_sha256 already exists, skip and log a duplicate_event.
data_flow_stages.failure_quarantine_behavior: Report artifact write failures (disk full, permission denied) retry 3x with 60s backoff, then emit rig.relay.report.write_failed and block the batch. No partial batches — atomic per batch_window.

data_flow_stages.name: JSON/JSONL Artifact → Postgres Operational Projection
data_flow_stages.artifact_path: Postgres tables (github_*) in the operational database
data_flow_stages.schema: Postgres DDL as defined in table catalog below
data_flow_stages.idempotency_key: ON CONFLICT (installation_id, org_slug, repo_name, resource_id, snapshot_at) DO UPDATE for mutable resources; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for immutable resources
data_flow_stages.redaction_rule: Postgres stores typed columns (structured data) + a single JSONB envelope column for non-typed fields. Envelope must not contain: raw source code, secret values, PII (email, ip_address), or internal file paths. Envelope is content-light by construction.
data_flow_stages.retention_rule: Per-table retention policies defined in table catalog. Default: snapshots retained 90 days, current-state retained indefinitely, rate-limit data retained 30 days.
data_flow_stages.replay_rule: Postgres projection is replayable from JSONL artifacts. A replay CLI replays a date range of JSONL into Postgres. Uses the idempotency keys to avoid duplicates. Designed for disaster recovery and schema migration re-projection.
data_flow_stages.failure_quarantine_behavior: Postgres write failures (constraint violation, type mismatch) roll back the batch transaction. Quarantine the offending JSONL line range to .rig/relay/github/quarantine/postgres/{table_name}_{timestamp}.json. Emit rig.relay.github.postgres.projection_failed event. The batch window is reduced on retry (binary search to find the bad row).

data_flow_stages.name: Postgres → DuckDB Analytical Projection
data_flow_stages.schema: DuckDB views and materialized tables derived from Postgres queries
data_flow_stages.redaction_rule: DuckDB projections are analytical aggregates (counts, sums, averages, time series). No row-level data unless required for a specific analytical question. No JSONB envelope data (only typed columns). Aggregations with count < 5 (deanonymization risk) are suppressed to zero.
data_flow_stages.retention_rule: DuckDB projections retained 180 days. Parquet files are partitioned by date. Monthly rollups retained 2 years.
data_flow_stages.replay_rule: DuckDB projections are fully replayable from Postgres. The projection_query_sha256 ensures deterministic replays. Schema changes to projections increment the projection_name version.
data_flow_stages.failure_quarantine_behavior: DuckDB projection failures (OOM, query timeout, type mismatch) retry with a smaller batch window. If consistent failure, emit rig.relay.github.duckdb.projection_failed and skip the batch. Failed batch ranges are logged for manual replay.

data_flow_stages.name: DuckDB → Cockpit/Static Docs/API
data_flow_stages.artifact_path: WebSocket projection stream, static HTML pages under docs/pages/github/, REST API endpoints
data_flow_stages.idempotency_key: WebSocket: message_id (UUIDv7). Static docs: page_sha256. API: ETag based on resource_sha256.
data_flow_stages.redaction_rule: Cockpit renders only aggregated views. Static docs are content-light (no raw code, no PII). API responses are scoped to the requesting user's RBAC role. Telemetry-disabled mode further suppresses actor_ids and repo_names in API responses.
data_flow_stages.retention_rule: WebSocket projections are ephemeral (no server-side retention). Static docs are regenerated on each build. API responses are ephemeral. The DuckDB source of truth retains the 180-day policy.
data_flow_stages.replay_rule: Cockpit re-subscribes via WebSocket and gets the current projection state. Static docs are fully rebuilt from DuckDB on each render. API responses are computed live from Postgres/DuckDB.
data_flow_stages.failure_quarantine_behavior: Cockpit projection failures (WebSocket disconnect) reconnect with exponential backoff. Static doc render failures block the docs build and emit a rig.relay.docs.render_failed event. API failures return 503 with a Retry-After header.

data_flow_stages.name: Invalid Webhook Quarantine
data_flow_stages.description: Webhook payloads that fail HMAC-SHA256 verification or schema validation are written to a quarantine directory with delivery ID, rejection reason, and timestamp. Quarantined payloads are never processed or projected. Operators can inspect quarantine for debugging.

data_flow_stages.name: Rate-Limited Deferred Queue
data_flow_stages.description: API requests that exceed the rate-limit budget are deferred with a retry-after timestamp. Security/audit/permission paths get priority over non-critical enrichment. Deferred events are not silently dropped.

data_flow_stages.name: Content-Light Scan Gate
data_flow_stages.description: All GitHub-derived data passes through content-light scanning before artifact creation. Scan checks for: secret fragments (ghp_, gho_, etc.), raw Actions log bodies, raw diffs, private repo content. Scanned data is classified as public-safe, private-local, sensitive-metadata, secret-bearing (rejected), or forbidden-raw (rejected). Scan results are recorded with SHA256 hashes.

data_flow_stages.name: Postgres Projection Invalidation
data_flow_stages.description: When source JSONL artifacts are updated, corresponding Postgres materialized views are invalidated. Invalidation events are recorded in an invalidation ledger. Cockpit projections show staleness warnings until views are refreshed.

content_light.description: All table schemas are abstract representations of the PostgreSQL DDL. No live data, no file paths with internal source code, and no secret-bearing columns are included. This document is designed to be content-light and git-diff friendly. JSONB envelope fields are described by their purpose, not by their exact values.
